protocol.purpose: D0-R development verification of non-NN causal dynamic increments and conditional joint empirical margins; not a fresh independent audit
protocol.input_policy: exact same existing state/disturbance/reward/action whitelist; only causal histories and internal derived quantities, no extra raw columns or UDP/Actor changes

data_policy.qualification: all v1 data roles have previous exposure; validation selects v2, so its metrics and coverage are development evidence, not independent acceptance; no newly untouched seeds are available

dynamic_model.name: causal_direct_fir_residual_increment
dynamic_model.qualification: finite-horizon direct linear regression, not a recursive ARX/modal solver; no stability or causal alternative-action guarantee is claimed
dynamic_model.target: measured signed My at each strict future frame minus current-My-anchored physical rollout; future observations used as training targets only
dynamic_model.features: current static residual/load and own/common residual history differences, own measured-load differences, causal wind changes and nacelle acceleration histories, current pitch/rotor/yaw/azimuth and causal motion derivatives
dynamic_model.future_steps: all 20ms frames through 0.50s; peak=max_abs of signed rollout for 0.10/0.20/0.50s
dynamic_model.candidate_policy: recorded PID ZOH only; no alternative-action prediction API in v2
dynamic_model.training_plan_eligibility: same v1 approximate-ZOH threshold, complete future through 0.50s; mismatch labels never enter features

selection.score: equal case/horizon average of normalized peak MAE plus 0.25 * p95 positive normalized underestimate
selection.tie_rule: first frozen candidate in protocol order
selection.qualification: validation reused to select history/ridge; all candidate scores saved, no audit-driven tuning

conditional_scale.target: log(max(abs(actual future peak - predicted future peak), 100000 Nm)) on training origins
conditional_scale.features: current wind/actual pitch/rotor plus abs current and lagged My increments/rates, current My scale and nacelle acceleration amplitudes; no PID peak reference in inputs
conditional_scale.qualification: train residuals determine error scale only; separate calibration cases determine empirical quantile; neither yields a certified bound

joint_margin.grouping: existing causal control region at origin
joint_margin.joint_score: max over all three blades and both primary horizons of positive underestimation divided by causal error scale
joint_margin.coverage_unit: simultaneous three blades x both windows at each eligible origin, not per-blade or whole-trajectory coverage
joint_margin.qualification: empirical correlated-origin quantile; not deterministic, distribution-free, or independent-seed confidence; missing groups are unknown

evaluation.tight_plan_role: evaluation-only sensitivity to v1 loose ZOH matching, not alternative-action truth
evaluation.strict_pid_exceedance_recall: not estimable: each trajectory defines its own complete-window maximum

base_protocol.purpose: PID offline feasibility only; no online control or protection authorization
base_protocol.input_policy: existing STATE_VARIABLES, DISTURBANCE_VARIABLES, REWARD_VARIABLES and two recorded ACTION_VARIABLES only; Time is audit metadata
base_protocol.recorded_action_provenance: legacy PID teacher contract interprets raw O_* as demand; raw headers alone do not prove this; current UDP DLL uses O_* measurement aliases, so demand-response and ZOH conclusions remain conditional until legacy provenance is verified
base_protocol.split_policy: entire CSV held out; no same-case time fragments shared across splits; one trajectory per wind is not multiple independent seeds

model.name: anchored_quasi_steady_greybox
model.surface: q_relative * polynomial(inflow_angle, actual_pitch) + q_axial * 1P/2P azimuth harmonics + apparent inertial acceleration terms
model.coefficient_fit: ridge least squares per existing control region and blade, using current training rows only
model.azimuth_convention: raw rotor azimuth + blade_index * 2pi/3; harmonic coefficients are fitted, not a verified BEM coordinate transformation
model.selection_rule: lowest validation mean absolute future-peak error divided by each case's frozen PID peak; deterministic first candidate on tie
model.candidate_plan: current recorded demand clipped to existing engineering bounds, then held constant; future recorded demands are evaluation-only
model.future_disturbance_assumption: hold current wind, yaw and nacelle accelerations; never read future observations
model.residual_rate: causal measured My derivative minus surface derivative from current pitch/rotor/azimuth motion while holding current disturbances
model.aerodynamic_torque_assumption: hold current inferred aerodynamic torque Tg + J * causal rotor acceleration over the short horizon

static_parameters.parameter_qualification: example engineering project, not verified identity of all historical PID cases; 0.67 effective radius is an explicit lumped approximation, not a measured variable

evaluation.coverage_gate_unit: simultaneous three-blade empirical coverage per region/horizon on approximate-ZOH PID origins; per-blade coverage is additionally reported; overlapping origins are not independent samples
evaluation.margin_semantics: positive-part empirical one-sided residual quantile in Nm; not a deterministic or distribution-free error bound
evaluation.event_semantics: PID near-peak episodes; timely means warning before onset within selected H; predictions generated after onset are late, not early successes
evaluation.strict_exceedance_semantics: own complete PID-window max_abs is never strictly exceeded by that same trajectory; strict exceedance recall is not estimable

candidate_sensitivity.qualification: model sensitivity only, no unexecuted-action physical labels

feasibility_gate.gate_scope: independent audit 0.1/0.2s; matched-plan point metrics, all PID episode diagnostics; missing groups/counts are inconclusive, not passes
feasibility_gate.on_failure: REVIEW_DO_NOT_INTEGRATE; do not tune on audit or silently change thresholds
feasibility_gate.on_success: PASS_OFFLINE_FEASIBILITY only; RL counterfactual validation and production gates still required

static_project.pitch_response: Position second order only; RateResponse.LagTime is not stacked
static_project.qualification: example engineering project, not verified identity of all historical PID cases; 0.67 effective radius is an explicit lumped approximation, not a measured variable
